state.native_evidence: Original SET0 warns when address>0xbfffffff but still enters its selector switch. Selectors5/6/7 store addresses in SRAM; selector15 later dereferences five saved bases and writes CPU indices. The current MT7996 caller sets MSDU page bases to BAR0+WFDMA0_BASE+0x500+{0xa0,0xb0,0xc0}; current DMA configuration selects WFDMA0 for these queues. WFDMA0_BASE=0xd4000. Original checked page5/6/7 callbacks already enforce capacities and retain BA claims, but their owner initializer is still invoked by old tests rather than the real wire path.
state.proposal: Pass actual PCI BAR0 start/length into mt76_npu_init. After initial provider session setup and before publishing mt76 NPU pointers, a provider callback binds base then length through two dedicated metadata commands in the same cold envelope/session/sequence. Firmware owns this one-shot anchor; geometry requires nonzero 4K-aligned base/length, no 32-bit/native aperture overflow, sufficient register span and no overlap with the six pinned loader regions. These metadata commands do not invoke a native hardware setter. Later page addresses must exactly match the registered BAR offsets and precede their corresponding one-shot DESC5/6/7 operations. First authenticated DESC5 initializes the BA owner from the immutable loader plan. Native failure retains claims/active/inflight; no reset, release, arm or retirement API is added. Selector15 and later indication/INODE/TXDONE operations remain denied until integrated.
state.scope: Canonical mainline experimental implementation and current actual C/native instruction checks. BAR geometry and native software lease are not physical memory ownership, previous-user exclusion, DMA/cache/drain/recovery or actual-client proof. The full NPU objective remains open.

anchor_authority.instructions: What does proposal establish by binding the actual PCI resource?

criteria.geometry_anchor: A once-owned source/address/extent anchor for later checks, not physical DMA retirement.
criteria.physical_retirement: A physical proof that all prior DMA users are retired.
criteria.rearm_authority: Permission to release or rearm the device.

selector15_scope.instructions: Does native_evidence describe selector15 as an operation that writes through multiple saved endpoint addresses, rather than only recording one scalar address?

private_init.instructions: Does proposal move first BA-owner initialization into an authenticated native DESC5 callback instead of relying on a direct test initializer?

failure_retention.instructions: Does proposal explicitly retain ambiguous failure ownership and omit reset/release/rearm/retirement?

full_objective.instructions: According to scope, is the full NPU objective complete?

criteria.not_complete: Further setup, physical and client gates remain open.
